title: SKU
description: SKU canonical v1 contract for Product Master. A SKU can be complete or active without being sellable; sellable belongs to Operational Core.
$comment: Sources: PACK-02 sections on SKU canonical, identifier no-reuse, audit history, and Product Activation dependency. Lifecycle values are governed by enums/product/sku-lifecycle-status.yaml.

sku_code.description: Canonical SKU code such as A1/CS/DM/HS from the current 19 SKU operational catalog; the schema remains extensible.

product_id.description: Owning product identifier. Ops-core v1 emits the same value as sku_id under OD-A6-01: Product and SKU are 1:1 identity aliases in this phase, not separate aggregates.

public_name.description: Public product name for the SKU.

dietary_type.description: Dietary grouping from the operational SKU catalog: Vegan / Man. TODO: confirm exact English label for Man.

lifecycle_status.description: Closed SKU lifecycle enum governed by enums/product/sku-lifecycle-status.yaml.

formula_version_id.description: Linked current Formula Version, usually G1 for operational production.

updated_at.description: UTC instant (RFC 3339, Z suffix) of the latest change to what this object publishes about the SKU: the SKU master record (names, product group, dietary type, lifecycle_status) or the packaging configuration of its trade items (the input of sellable_uoms). A SKU that was never edited after creation carries its creation instant, so the value is never null. NOT covered: a change of the four linked pointers formula_version_id, recipe_id, bom_id and activation_id. Emitted on every SKU object by an ops-core build that carries SKU-M12-03; it is optional in the schema only so that a consumer which validates responses of an older provider keeps working.

revision.description: Monotonic change marker of this SKU object, an integer that is strictly greater after every change counted by updated_at. Compare it only against an earlier value of the SAME sku_id (equal = unchanged, greater = changed); never between two SKUs, never as a count of changes, and do not assume steps of one or gap-free values. The provider may derive it from the change instant today and move to a stored counter later without a contract change. A value LOWER than the one a consumer stored for the same sku_id means the provider data was restored from a backup: re-read the SKU and replace the stored copy. Optional in the schema for the same reason as updated_at.

sellable_uoms.description: Units this SKU can be sold in, from its ACTIVE trade items: at most one hộp entry (BOX trade item, with units_per_box) and one thùng entry (CARTON trade item, with boxes_per_carton), hộp first. An empty array means the SKU has no ACTIVE BOX or CARTON trade item yet; it is never omitted and never null. Only the two codes hộp and thùng appear. A consumer that sells in one unit must find that unit here before it asks POST /v1/availability/check about it; a unit missing from the array is not sellable, whatever the stock is.
